findings.title: deliverBatch can throw when a target throws an unstringifiable value
findings.evidence: ts/src/stage/panelBridge.ts:671 String(error) in the catch block; probe: throw Object.create(null) gives 'NULLPROTO THREW TypeError: Cannot convert object to primitive value'; throw {toString(){throw}} gives 'THROWOBJ THREW Error: x'
findings.consequence: Violates the never-throws contract (ADR-029 s6 point 4) and aborts the remaining targets, for exotic thrown values only; no test covers a non-Error throw
findings.minimal_fix: Build the error message in a helper that wraps String(error) in its own try/catch with a fixed fallback string; add a test throwing Object.create(null)

findings.title: Duplicate paths: requested and receipt disagree, and the target receives a deduplicated list
findings.evidence: panelBridge.ts:646-647 and :657; probe deliverBatch(['a','a','b']) returned requested ['a','a','b'] with delivered ['a','b']; the docblock at :639-641 admits it; no test
findings.consequence: N-in-N-accounted and 'full ordered list' (ADR-029 s6 points 2 and 3) are false for duplicate input; wbf-05's 'opened X of Y' could show a mismatch with nothing declined
findings.minimal_fix: Dedupe requested too, or tell wbf-05 to compute Y from the receipt and dedupe at the caller; add one test

findings.title: isBatchAvailable is not reactive; no availability hook over a target list
findings.evidence: panelBridge.ts:680-686 reads resolve() at call time with no subscription; ADR-029 s6 point 5 says 'the availability hook reads null'; the test calls it outside React
findings.consequence: A render that calls isBatchAvailable without also calling the plural hooks for every listed channel will not update when a panel registers or unregisters, leaving a stale disabled state (R08)
findings.minimal_fix: Document that a plural hook per listed channel must run in the same component, or add useBatchAvailable(targets) over useSyncExternalStore with a rendered test

findings.title: Keyless-caller compatibility proved by types and stubs, not by the real regions
findings.evidence: All 28 tests in panelBridge.test.tsx use viewerStub/terminalStub; none mounts HtmlViewerRegion or TerminalRegion; tsc -b passes and the 10-mutant run shows the slot semantics are pinned
findings.consequence: A later change to a region's register effect would not be caught by this phase's tests; low risk
findings.minimal_fix: None required here; wbf-05's HtmlViewerRegion test should cover the real register/unregister
